rule: Inspect all eight source diagnostics in all three fixed draws. Retain if absolute median discrepancy <=0.12 percentage points, quartile discrepancy <=0.15 points, and age-slope discrepancy <=0.004 points/year in every draw. If a statistic exceeds its tolerance with the same discrepancy direction in all three draws, consider one interpretable location/dispersion revision; first assess estimator mapping, Monte Carlo fluctuation and artificial source-covariate mismatch. Do not tune BMI slopes, insert restricted coefficients, use quarantined quantiles, or optimize target results. If incompatible source reconstruction explains discrepancies, retaining with limitation is permitted; no automatic numeric winner. Any revision must preserve this recipe and evidence and rerun all three seeds. Select scientific model before any target execution.
status_of_thresholds: Heuristic construction-review thresholds, not uncertainty limits or validation cutoffs.
